title: Hestan — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Hestan.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Inspired by the Restaurant." Luxury tier. Hestan started as a commercial kitchen equipment manufacturer — their restaurant ranges and ovens are in Michelin-starred kitchens worldwide. The residential line brings that commercial DNA home with Marquise sealed burners hitting 30,000 BTU, the highest in residential. Available in 12 signature colors plus custom Pantone matches. Hestan is the rising challenger to Wolf and BlueStar.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Serious home cooks who want restaurant-grade performance. Custom color kitchen builds. Buyers cross-shopping Wolf and BlueStar.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Hestan:

• 30,000 BTU Marquise burners — highest output sealed burner in residential

• Commercial kitchen heritage — same engineers who build Michelin-star restaurant equipment

• 12 signature colors plus custom Pantone — rivals BlueStar on customization

• Infrared sear burner reaches 1000°F — restaurant-level searing at home

• Rising luxury brand with serious credibility from the commercial side
